name: list_claimable
description: Items you could claim now: unclaimed, ready or in review, in a queue you serve, in a project you were admitted to as a member. Items in a project's active sprint come first, then by priority and due date. Returns {items:[{key,title,level,kind,status,priority,estimate,queue,queueKey,productKey,parentKey,dueOn}]}. An unknown or hidden project is "Not found."

limit.description: Most items to return; default 20, at most 50.
